analysis_v1.description: Initial job-fit analysis prompt with general instructions for structured JSON output.
analysis_v1.intended_improvement: Establish baseline structured resume-to-job analysis behavior.

analysis_v2.description: Stricter job-fit evaluation prompt with explicit scoring bands and skill matching rules.
analysis_v2.intended_improvement: Improve missing-skill detection, reduce hallucinated matches, and make scoring more consistent.

resume_review_v1.description: Resume review prompt for grounded, evidence-backed resume improvement suggestions.
resume_review_v1.intended_improvement: Provide truthful resume guidance without inventing experience.

cover_letter_v1.description: Cover letter generation prompt using only the resume and job description.
cover_letter_v1.intended_improvement: Generate truthful, job-specific cover letters without fabricating experience.

interview_prep_v1.description: Interview preparation prompt for technical, behavioral, and project-specific questions.
interview_prep_v1.intended_improvement: Generate grounded interview prep from resume and job description.

cover_letter_v2.description: Cover letter as strict structured output: three body paragraphs, each with verbatim supporting resume quotes, plus a closing sentence. Greeting is added in code.
cover_letter_v2.intended_improvement: Remove post-hoc string patching and make every claim checkable against the resume.

interview_prep_v2.description: Interview prep with project questions derived from the submitted resume instead of hardcoded project names.
interview_prep_v2.intended_improvement: Work for any user's resume; rely on strict structured outputs for the JSON shape.

job_requirements_v1.description: LLM extraction of required vs preferred skills from a job description.
job_requirements_v1.intended_improvement: Separate must-have from nice-to-have skills more reliably than heading heuristics.

skill_match_v1.description: Per-skill comparison: each job skill with priority, whether the resume shows it, and a verbatim resume quote as evidence.
skill_match_v1.intended_improvement: Give the deterministic verifier checkable claims (exact quotes) instead of free-form matched/missing lists.

draft_section_v1.description: Drafts one application section (cover letter paragraph, resume bullet, summary, interview answer) from numbered resume evidence, listing each factual claim with the evidence ids that support it.
draft_section_v1.intended_improvement: Make every drafted claim traceable to resume chunks so verify_claims can check it.
